HACKATHON GUARDRAILS (non-negotiable):
- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.
- Read docs/DESIGN.md sections named in your task before writing code. src/types.ts is the shared contract:
  if you need a change, make it minimal and say so in your final message.
- Touch only the files your task OWNS. Never edit another task's files, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, setups/, experiments/.

  unless your task says so. Fixtures are built by scripts from real samples, never hand-invented payloads.
- Commit in small steps as work lands, message prefix "<task id>: ". Never rewrite history. Never commit secrets or .env.
- Never describe unbuilt work as done in README/docs. No numbers in docs except those generated into docs/FACTS.md.
- Use `entire graph impact --symbol <name> --json` (or `entire graph query`) before editing an existing module, if available.

TASK T25 · W3 · DeepSeek-backed candidate setups: harness env + time-of-day pricing
GOAL: Let candidate setups run the Claude Code harness against DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint, and price their runs
correctly (DeepSeek bills peak and off-peak rates).
READ: docs/DESIGN.md §"Candidate generation", §"Harness adapters"; setups/candidates/E.json, F.json; src/harness/claude.ts;
src/price/index.ts. Pricing source: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing (read it; copy numbers only from it).
OWNS: src/harness/provider.ts, src/price/deepseek.ts, tests/provider.test.ts, tests/price-deepseek.test.ts, and adding DeepSeek rows
to src/price/prices.json (rows only; don't change existing rows)
BUILD: providerEnv(setup, env) → Record<string,string> resolving `${VAR}` values from the given env (missing → throw with the variable
name, never print values); the result is what src/harness/claude.ts passes to the child. priceDeepSeek(model, tokens, at: Date) using
peak hours 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC Mon–Fri (off-peak = half), cache-hit vs cache-miss input; rows carry source_url and
checked_on. A live opt-in test (ROSTER_LIVE=1, needs DEEPSEEK_API_KEY) runs a trivial `claude -p` through setup E and asserts a
result event.
ACCEPTANCE: unit tests for env resolution (incl. missing var), peak/off-peak boundaries (UTC), weekend, and unknown model → null.
TEST: bun test tests/provider.test.ts tests/price-deepseek.test.ts
DO NOT TOUCH: existing price rows, src/harness/claude.ts (report the one-line integration point in your final message).
I'll start by reading the design sections, the setups, the existing harness and pricing code, and the current price table.
